question: The interface vocabulary has no token for an HTTP proxy or a SOCKS5 proxy endpoint. ip-proxy/webshare-free-plan uses rest and cli (its management API and CLI) and names the HTTP and SOCKS5 transports in interface_detail. Should interface[] gain terms such as http-proxy and socks5?
why: The proxied traffic itself, the thing the offer sells, is invisible to a filter on interfaces; several ip-proxy records already carry the same gap in their text (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12).
